<script>

/* ===== SCRIPT GỐC CỦA EXTERNAL-X ===== */

setInterval(function () {
    document.querySelectorAll("div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll("div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach((el) => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll("div[style='height: 65px;']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
}, 10);

document.querySelectorAll(".menu-itemX1").forEach((item)=>{
    item.addEventListener("click",()=>{
        const action=item.dataset.action;
        switch(action){
            case "TronMau":showmodal2('/Home/TronMau','/tron-mau');break;
            case "TracNghiem":showmodal2('/Home/TracNghiemX_Multiple','/trac-nghiem-index');break;
            case "Question":window.open("/Home/PlayQuestion_Multiple","_blank");break;
            case "Karaoke":showmodal2('/Home/ToPlayKaraoke','/karaoke');break;
            case "GameRanSanMoi":window.open("/game-ran-san-moi","_blank");break;
            case "GameCoCaro":window.open("/game-co-caro","_blank");break;
            case "GameDapChuot":window.open("/game-dap-chuot","_blank");break;
            case "GameNeVatThe":window.open("/game-ne-tranh-vat-the","_blank");break;
            case "GameWordle":window.open("/game-wordle","_blank");break;
            case "GameBrickBreaker":window.open("/game-brick-breaker","_blank");break;
            case "GameQuickMath":window.open("/game-quick-math","_blank");break;
            case "GameSlidingPuzzle":window.open("/game-sliding-puzzle","_blank");break;
            case "GamePingPongArena":window.open("/game-ping-pong-arena","_blank");break;
            case "GameFlappyBird":window.open("/game-flappy-bird","_blank");break;
            case "GameTyping":window.open("/game-typing","_blank");break;
            case "GameMemory":window.open("/game-memory","_blank");break;
            case "GameCarDodging":window.open("/game-car-dodging","_blank");break;
            case "GameColorMatch":window.open("/game-color-match","_blank");break;
            case "GameHangMan":window.open("/game-hangman","_blank");break;
            case "GameMinesweeper":window.open("/game-minesweeper","_blank");break;
            case "GameSpaceInvaders":window.open("/game-space-invaders","_blank");break;
            case "GameDinoRunner":window.open("/game-dino-runner","_blank");break;
            case "GameFruitNinja":window.open("/game-fruit-ninja","_blank");break;
            case "GameCatchFallingObjects":window.open("/game-catch-falling-objects","_blank");break;
            case "GameTetris":window.open("/game-tetris","_blank");break;
            case "GameConnectFour":window.open("/game-connect-four","_blank");break;
            case "GameLightsOut":window.open("/game-lights-out","_blank");break;
            case "GameTowerOfHanoi":window.open("/game-tower-of-hanoi","_blank");break;
            case "GameSimonSays":window.open("/game-simon-says","_blank");break;
            case "GameMastermind":window.open("/game-mastermind","_blank");break;
            case "GameMatch3":window.open("/game-match-3","_blank");break;
            case "GameReactionTime":window.open("/game-reaction-time","_blank");break;
            case "Studocu":showmodal1();break;
            /* case "Studocu":window.open("/lay-tai-lieu-tu-stoducu","_blank");break; */
        }
    });
});

function yes1(){window.open("/lay-tai-lieu-tu-stoducu","_blank");}
function no1(){window.open("/xac-thuc-1","_blank");}
function showmodal1(){document.getElementById("modal1").classList.add("show");}
function showmodal2(o,n){urlChooseOld=o;urlChooseNew=n;document.getElementById("modal2").classList.add("show");}

function closemodal1() {
    document.getElementById("modal1").classList.remove("show");
}

function closemodal2() {
    urlChooseOld = "";
    urlChooseNew = "";
    document.getElementById("modal2").classList.remove("show");
}

function cu2(){window.open(urlChooseOld,"_blank");}
function moi2(){window.open(urlChooseNew,"_blank");}

let urlChooseOld="",urlChooseNew="";

</script>
